body: Hey @past, can we please include https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10208 in the next meeting's agenda? Thanks!

Thank you all for attending the meeting today! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10318):

### Agenda  
Attendees: Michael Smith, Joey Arhar, Panos Astithas, Steve Becker, Gabriel Brito, Mason Freed, Sanket Joshi, Olli Pettay, Chris Wilson, Chris Harrelson

1. Review past action items
    1. Dom will update the [post-insertion steps PR](https://github.com/whatwg/dom/pull/1261) to address Olli's review.
        1. Done. Olli will continue looking into this.
    1. Chris H., Chris W. and Panos will follow up and revisit minuting the meetings at the next meeting.
        1. Panos will schedule a meeting and bring this up again next week.
    1. Emilio will look closer at the use cases for [CloseWatcher always fire cancel events](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10291).
        1. Carry over.
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. [Addison] Joint session with the I18N WG. Addison will provide a list of topics.
        1. Deferring until May 9.
    1. [Yoav] [Add subresource integrity support for ES modules, through importmaps](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10269)
        1. Deferring until May 9.
1. New topics
    1. [Gabriel] [Proposal: pause iframe media when not rendered](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10208)
        1. [Explainer](https://github.com/MicrosoftEdge/MSEdgeExplainers/blob/main/IframeMediaPause/iframe_media_pausing.md). Perf and UX are the main motivations. Feedback is welcome.
        1. Mason asks how this interacts with content visibility.
        1. Chris indicates that there will be no adverse interactions.
        1. Olli asks about why the proposal uses permission policies.
        1. Gabriel describes the need for centralized control, but is open to other ideas.
        1. Joey suggests adding the same feature to iframes.
        1. Sanket asks about the relation to the [other proposal](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9793).
        1. Mason points out that it would be more productive to have this discussion with the HTML spec editors present.
        1. Michael asks if it's possible to mute the iframe without a permission policy. 
        1. Gabriel explains how this proposal fits into the existing framework. 
        1. Steve says that they are open to exploring other options. 
        1. Sanket asks to confirm if the folks present have concerns with the concept, separately from the shape of the feature. 
        1. Olli and Mason agree that the concept seems fine. 
    1. [Joey] [HTML parser changes for stylable `<select>`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10310)
        1. Olli says Henri should look into this and that Mozilla folks are looking into select and combobox improvements in OpenUI. 
        1. Mason says that the latter is waiting for some feedback on the former first. 
        1. Michael asks about site breakage. 
        1. Joey describes the results he shared in the issue. 
        1. Michael suggests that a separate section on breakage would be helpful. 
        1. Olli will ask Henri to look into this from a parser parser point of view. 
    1. [Panos] [Meeting 1](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10316) for joint OpenUI-WHATWG/HTML-CSSWG task force on styleable form controls on Wednesday May 8, 2024 at 8am PDT. The meeting will take place in the CSSWG Zoom meeting room and IRC channel.
        1. Mason asks for the agenda. Panos will post it in the issue once it's published in [www-style](https://lists.w3.org/Archives/Public/www-style/2024May/).

### Action Items

1. @past will schedule a meeting to discuss minuting and bring this up again next week.
1. @smaug---- will ask Henri to look into [HTML parser changes for stylable `<select>`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10310) from a parser point of view.
1. @past will post the agenda for the joint meeting on that issue.
